# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/world_tension.mjs, docs/specs/03_gameplay/05_world_tension_and_endings.md). Do not edit by hand.
# Triggers of the Gathering Dark and the endings. Global; any scope.
zin_world_gd_tier_1 = {
	# Seeming Peace: the Gathering Dark from 0 to below 25.
	check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark < 25 }
}
zin_world_gd_tier_2 = {
	# Unease: the Gathering Dark from 25 to below 50.
	check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 25 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark < 50 }
}
zin_world_gd_tier_3 = {
	# The Gathering Dark: the Gathering Dark from 50 to below 75.
	check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark < 75 }
}
zin_world_gd_tier_4 = {
	# The Last Crowns: the Gathering Dark from 75.
	check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}
zin_world_great_war_exists = {
	# A war with a major on each side.
	any_country = {
		is_major = yes
		has_war = yes
		any_enemy_country = { is_major = yes }
	}
}
zin_world_peace_holds = {
	# The Long Peace: the meter below 25 and no war with a major on each side.
	check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark < 25 }
	NOT = { zin_world_great_war_exists = yes }
}
zin_world_player_front_open = {
	# Q-80: under HISTORICAL a player's own front opens the War of the Last Crowns early (the owners of data/world_tension.json war.playerFronts).
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_leren_withdrawal
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				zin_is_lerendor = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_western_crossing
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				zin_west_is_leader = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_mirolon_fallen
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				zin_is_volgan = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				zin_is_volgan = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_zol_rising
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				zin_is_zol = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_world_dark_war = {
	# A dark power at war with a major that is not a dark power (the PLAUSIBLE and FREE start of the War of the Last Crowns).
	any_country = {
		zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes
		any_enemy_country = {
			is_major = yes
			NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
		}
	}
}
zin_world_canon_in_reach = {
	# E-01: a canon ending is in reach while the heir is at stage 9 to 12, not lost and not yet crowned, and Afrit lives or the palace is pending.
	check_variable = { var = global.zin_eindil_stage value = 9 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage < 13 }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_lost }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned }
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead }
		check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp25 = 0 }
	}
}
zin_world_judgement_open = {
	# The proposed outcomes are judged on the judgement date when the age has left history enough (zin_path_departure 15 or more) or no canon ending
	# is in reach; otherwise once, on the deferred date (E-01, SL-26).
	OR = {
		AND = {
			zin_world_date_judgement = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = { var = global.zin_path_departure value = 15 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { zin_world_canon_in_reach = yes }
			}
		}
		zin_world_date_judgement_deferred = yes
	}
}
zin_world_golden_court_holds = {
	# Outcome 4 (SL-25, E-04): an Aenor realm controls Parim, and the Golden King rules it or the Regency of Gold does. A King who went into exile
	# when his realm fell (zin_golden_king_exiled) rules no court. A King who died of old age after surviving the Council
	# (zin_golden_king_old_age, K59, Q-86) is dead like any other: the outcome then holds only through the Regency of Gold (owner, 25 October 2026).
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_exiled }
	any_state = {
		OR = {
			zin_is_site_parim = yes
			state = 1019
		}
		controller = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead }
		has_global_flag = zin_aenor_regency_endures
	}
}
zin_world_western_crown_holds = {
	# Outcome 5 (SL-19): the Western Crossing's zin_west_holds_parim; or, while the key-sites table is pending (its zin_is_site_parim is an inert
	# stand-in), a West Lands realm controls Aenor's capital state and has claimed its throne, or no Aenor realm is left to claim it back.
	OR = {
		zin_west_holds_parim = yes
		AND = {
			any_state = {
				OR = {
					zin_is_site_parim = yes
					state = 1019
				}
				controller = { has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands }
			}
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = zin_west_throne_claimed
				NOT = { any_country = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_world_strait_master_holds = {
	# Outcome 6: Lerendor sought the strait for itself and holds both its shores.
	has_global_flag = zin_leren_strait_supremacy
	any_country = {
		zin_is_lerendor = yes
		zin_leren_holds_strait = yes
	}
}
zin_world_eastern_king_holds = {
	# Outcome 7: the East is united, and the false god is dead or was never its king.
	has_global_flag = zin_east_united
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead
		NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east }
	}
}
